Connect, Play, and Manage Sports Activities

The ultimate platform for casual athletes and sports clubs. Organize games with friends or manage your entire facility — all in one powerful app.

Join 50,000+ athletes already using Makes Sport

For Casual Athletes

Connect with Friends

Create groups, invite friends, and organize sports activities together. Never play alone again.

Find Nearby Venues

Discover sports facilities, courts, and fields near you. Book instantly through the app.

Easy Scheduling

Plan games, set recurring events, and get automatic reminders. Stay organized effortlessly.

Track Your Progress

Monitor your activity stats, achievements, and personal records across all your sports.

How Makes Sport Works

Get started in three simple steps and join thousands of athletes

Download the App

Available on iOS and Android. Install and create your free account in seconds.

Set Up Your Profile

Add your sports preferences, location, and connect with friends to get started.

Start Playing

Find activities, join events, or organize your own games. It's that simple!

For Sports Clubs & Facilities

Complete management solution for your sports business

Event Management

Create and manage classes, tournaments, and special events with built-in registration and capacity limits.

Facility Rentals

Manage court and field bookings with real-time availability, automated pricing, and instant confirmations.

Payment Processing

Accept payments for memberships, classes, and rentals. Automated invoicing and financial reporting included.

Member Management

Track memberships, attendance, and customer relationships all in one place with powerful CRM tools.

Analytics & Insights

Understand your business with detailed reports on bookings, revenue, peak times, and customer behavior.

Marketing Tools

Promote your events, send notifications to members, and grow your business with built-in marketing features.

Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to the most common questions about Makes Sport
